title: What If Every Human Vanished Overnight?

scenes.text: What if all humans vanished tonight? Within 36 hours, New York's subway starts flooding.
Pumps move about 13 million gallons a day. With no power, the water comes back.
Within two weeks, reactors lose cooling once backup diesel runs out, and many could fail.
In 10 to 20 years, roads crack and skyscrapers suffer water damage. Forests overtake cities in 20 to 40 years.
After a century or two, most bridges and dams fail. Wildlife rebounds, as it did around Chernobyl.
Plastic bottles take 450 years or more to break down. Our trash would outlast our cities.

description:
What if every human vanished overnight?
Cities would flood, reactors would fail, and forests would take over within decades.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: What's the first place you'd go to see nature take over? Drop your own 'what if'.
